system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

The Uzumaki’s are known for their unmatched stamina and chakra reserves. Increase your Chakra point total by 2. Every level thereafter, increase your chakra point total by 2.

Additionally, this reserve of chakra stabilizes within you as pockets of self-energizing stores of chakra. This reserve of Chakra can be call upon and is known as Spiral Cells, of which you have 2. Once per turn, at the beginning of your turn, while you are not incapacitated or have ranks of Sealed you can call on this energy and spend 1 Spiral Cell. When you do, you gain 4 Temporary Chakra points. You regain spent Spiral Cells when you complete a rest.

Beginning at 7th level, increase the total number of Spiral Cells you have to 4. Also, when you would take chakra damage or gain ranks of a Mental or Sensory condition you can spend 1 Spiral Cell to reduce the damage taken by an amount equal to your level or ranks of the condition gained to 0.

Beginning at 11th level, increase the Temporary Chakra points gained to 6.

Beginning at 15th level, increase the total number of Spiral Cells you have to 6.
